adopt.alien: DayZ is running on this machine ({s}, PID {pid}), but it is not ours{port}. The port may be taken.
cfg.bad_enc: Encoding is {enc} — will be saved as UTF-8 without BOM
cfg.hint: Only values are changed — comments and file structure are preserved.

cfg.saved: Config saved as UTF-8 without BOM.
cfgvar.MaxPing: Ping (ms) at which a player is kicked from the server.
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerHitsOnly: 1 — log player hits only, 0 — all hits (animals/infected).
cfgvar.adminLogPlayerList: Periodic player list with positions (every 5 minutes).
cfgvar.allowFilePatching: Allow clients with -filePatching (required for debugging unpacked sources).
cfgvar.clientPort: Forces the port clients connect with.
cfgvar.defaultObjectViewDistance: Highest object render distance on the server.
cfgvar.defaultVisibility: Highest terrain render distance on the server.
cfgvar.description: Server description in the server browser (up to 255 characters).
cfgvar.disablePersonalLight: Disable personal light for all connected clients.
cfgvar.disableRespawnDialog: Hide the respawn point selection dialog.
cfgvar.enableDebugMonitor: Show the debug monitor to players.
cfgvar.forceSameBuild: Only allow clients with the same game build.
cfgvar.guaranteedUpdates: Communication protocol with the game server (use only 1).
cfgvar.hostname: Server name shown in the server browser.
cfgvar.instanceId: Instance identifier (storage_<id> folder inside the mission).
cfgvar.logAverageFps: Log average server FPS every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logFile: Server console log file in the profile folder.
cfgvar.logMemory: Log memory usage every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.logPlayers: Log connected player count every N seconds (needs -doLogs).
cfgvar.loginQueueConcurrentPlayers: How many players are processed concurrently during login.
cfgvar.loginQueueMaxPlayers: Maximum number of players waiting in the login queue.
cfgvar.multithreadedReplication: Multithreaded replication (thread count comes from dayzsettings.xml).
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchBandwidthLimit: The limit itself: fraction [0,1] or number [1,∞) — depends on the setting above.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchCompute: Objects checked for create/delete per server frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchEnforceBandwidt: Limit object creation based on bandwidth usage.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchLogSlow: Threshold (sec): logs a network "bubble" if processing takes longer.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendCreate: Maximum objects sent for creation per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchSendDelete: Maximum objects sent for deletion per frame.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseDynamicMaxim: Bandwidth limit as a fraction of the current maximum, not a hard number.
cfgvar.networkObjectBatchUseEstimatedBan: 0 — actual data sent last frame, 1 — rough estimate.
cfgvar.networkRangeClose: Network bubble (m): close objects with items inside (backpacks). Default 20.
cfgvar.networkRangeNear: Network bubble (m): near inventory items. Default 150.
cfgvar.password: Password to join the server (empty — no password).
cfgvar.pingCritical: Ping (ms) at which the red ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.pingWarning: Ping (ms) at which the yellow ping warning is shown.
cfgvar.respawnTime: Delay (seconds) before a new character can be created after death.
cfgvar.serverFpsWarning: Server FPS below which the warning is shown (minimum 11).
cfgvar.simulatedPlayersBatch: Limit of players simulated per server frame.
cfgvar.timeStampFormat: Timestamp format in the RPT: Full or Short.
cfgvar.verifySignatures: PBO signature verification: 2 — enabled (.bikey files required in keys), 0 — disabled (for development).

filepatch.clear_confirm:
Remove all filepatching links from every root?

The script folders on drive P: are left untouched — only the links to them are removed.
filepatch.clear_tip: Removes only the links created by this button. Mods and other directory contents are left alone.
filepatch.err_no_roots: No client or server path is set — there is nowhere to put the links.
filepatch.err_not_p: The folder must be on drive P:. Selected: {p}
filepatch.err_real_dir: {p}: a real folder already exists here — it was left untouched
filepatch.err_root: The root of drive P: cannot be linked — pick your mod's scripts folder.
filepatch.help:
The symlink is what makes filepatching work. Filepatching lets you pick up script changes without repacking the PBO — restarting the client and server is enough.

To set it up, point to your mod's scripts folder on drive P:. The links will then be created automatically everywhere they are needed — in both client and server, stable and Experimental.
filepatch.pick: Mod scripts folder on drive P:
filepatch.sync_tip: Creates any missing links in all roots and removes those whose folder on drive P: is gone.
flags.hint: Flags are mod labels with a custom name and color. The color paints the mod's name in the lists. Assigned via right-click on a mod on the «Mods» tab → «Flags».
flags.title: Mod flags
launch.client_be_failed: Could not identify the running DayZ_x64 within {sec} seconds. Check the game window.
launch.server_died: Server exited during startup (code {code}). Check the RPT log.
launch.server_restarted: The previous server launch was replaced by a new command.
launch.server_slow: Server {what} within {sec} s — starting the client anyway.
launch.window_hidden: Server window hidden ({n} window(s), after {t:.1f} s)
launch.window_never_shown: The server window never appeared — the launch-time request was enough
log.clear_tip: Clears the window; log files are not touched.
log.delete_tip: Deletes all log files in the folder. The window is not cleared.
log.kind_tip: Scripts — mod errors; crashes — why the launch failed; RPT — the engine's full journal.
log.no_files: No files of this kind in the folder.
log.no_session: Waiting for a new log file…
log.on_top_tip: The window will not slip behind the game or the editor.
log.only_matches_tip: Keep only matching lines. The search then runs over the files on disk, not over what is shown.

mods.add_dir_pick: Folder with mods or a single @mod folder

mods.add_none: No @mods in the folder — nothing to add.
mods.add_ok_dir: Folder added. Valid mods: {v}, with problems: {p}

mods.flags_btn_tip: Custom mod labels (name + color) — assigned via right-click on a mod.

param.BEpath: Custom path to the BattlEye files.
param.adminLog: Writes a log of admin actions and hits (ADM file).
param.battleye: Enable/disable BattlEye. For Diag and local development set 0 (disabled).
param.cpuCount: Number of CPU cores the server may use.
param.doLogs: Enables server logs (RPT, script.log) in the profile folder.
param.filePatching: Allows loading unpacked files (sources) over PBOs. Required for debugging without packing. Diag builds usually require 1.
param.freezeCheck: Watches for server freezes and writes a dump on freeze.
param.limitFPS: Server loop FPS limit, max 200 (reduces CPU load).
param.name: Client character name.
param.netLog: Enables network traffic logging. Rarely needed, slows the server down.
param.newErrorsAreWarnings: New script errors are treated as warnings — the game does not crash on them (Diag only).
param.noPause: Do not pause the game when the window is minimized/unfocused.
param.password: Server password, if set in serverDZ.cfg (password).
param.scrDef: Script preprocessor definitions, e.g. BITWISEDEBUG (Diag only).
param.storage: Custom root folder for the storage (persistence files).
param.window: Start the client in windowed mode.
pbo.builder_hint: Select an addon containing config.cpp or a root containing several addons. Results are published atomically to Addons and public keys to Keys.
pbo.appid_tip: Leave empty unless this is paid DLC content.
pbo.b_tip: Checks mission.sqm and config.cpp for errors via a trial binarisation.
pbo.c_tip: “All bets are off” — rebuilds absolutely everything, including what hasn't changed.
pbo.clean_meta_tip: *.meta is Workbench clutter that throws off comparing source/pbo dates.
pbo.d_tip: png files successfully converted to paa are deleted from the temp folder.
pbo.extra_hint: Recognised as-is from previous settings — appended unchanged at the end.
pbo.g_tip: This option is not used by the embedded backend.
pbo.h_tip: DayZ sometimes uses png directly — disables the attempt to convert it to paa.
pbo.k_file_tip: Needed if PBO signing is enabled above.
pbo.k_tip: Creates a .bisign next to the pbo and puts the public key in keys/. If a private key is set below, signing is enabled automatically regardless of this toggle.
pbo.n_tip: A lot of extra output — useful when tracking down an error, but noticeably slows down packing.
pbo.o_tip: Protects sources from being viewed in a hex editor, but an obfuscated pbo can no longer be extracted.
pbo.p_tip: Builds run without an external GUI.
pbo.q: Delete wav/wss after converting to ogg
pbo.title: PBO Builder settings
pbo.tri_tip: Click cycles: empty — don't pass the option, «+» — enable, «−» — disable.
pbo.x_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that won't go into the pbo at all.
pbo.z_excl_tip: Comma-separated files/masks that shouldn't be compressed (e.g. *.paa,*.ogg).
pbo.z_tip: The compression-exclusion list is a separate field below.

Delete storage_* in mission "{m}"?
Loot, characters and bases will be reset.

preset.lazy_diag_desc: The game runs in diagnostic mode, filepatching works.

preset.name: Name
preset.name_reserved: The name "{n}" is reserved for map templates.
preset.name_taken: A preset "{n}" for this map already exists.
preset.no_profile: The profile folder doesn't exist yet — it will be created on launch.

preset.server_ip_tip: Address the client connects to. Use 127.0.0.1 for a local server.

repack_settings.convert: Convert config.cpp and RVMAT to BIN (CfgConvert)
repack_settings.convert_tip: Creates binary config.bin and RVMAT files using CfgConvert from DayZ Tools.
repack_settings.exclude_tip: File and folder patterns that will not be packed into the PBO. Separate them with commas, semicolons or new lines.

repack_settings.preflight_tip: Checks configs, addon structure, P3D files and references before creating the PBO.
repack_settings.processes_tip: Number of operations to run at once. 0 — detect automatically from the CPU.
repack_settings.sign_tip: Creates .bisign files using DSSignFile. A private key is required below.
repack_settings.title: Shared PBO build settings
settings.admin_pass_tip: Up to 32 characters, Latin letters/digits/symbols — no Cyrillic or spaces. Empty means admin login without a password (vppDisablePassword = 1 in serverDZ.cfg).
settings.admins_tip: Admin SteamID64s — one per line. Used by admin mods.
settings.quit_on_close: Quit the application when clicking X

settings.downloads_tip: Shared storage for downloaded map mods; they are attached to every root via junction links.

settings.engine_no_pbo: The built-in PBO Builder is available.
settings.engine_no_tools: Packing unavailable: DayZ Tools not found.

settings.pbo_settings_tip: Shared settings for automatic repacking and the separate PBO Builder tab.
settings.prefix_tip: Inserted into the hostname of created servers.
settings.steam_key_hint: Not required: mod dependencies and SteamID-from-link are resolved without it too, by reading Steam pages. How to get it: press «Get», sign in to Steam, put anything in the «Domain Name» field (localhost, for example), accept the terms and copy the key here.
settings.stop_method: How to stop the server and client
settings.stop_method_tip: The gentle way lets the server finish in its own order and save its data; the hard way cuts it off at once.
sid.add_tip: Add a SteamID or a profile link

sid.dlg_head: SteamID64 or a link to a Steam profile

Next: create or pick a preset, attach mods on the "Mods" tab

wizard.redetect_tip: Re-reads Steam libraries and fills in empty fields.
wizard.steam_sub: The field is optional and easy to fill in later in Settings — but it's simplest not to forget it now.
